statement: The Runtime reads the account's stored nonce from the chain and never derives it, and refuses to sign any proof at stored + 1 (either author): the first signed proof of a new epoch takes nonce stored + 2 or higher, because a Right-authored proof at stored + 1 only ties the implicit proof and cannot outrank it. The Quint cell holds the first signed proof of an epoch taking its nonce from the stored nonce read from the chain (settle.qnt, first-proof-nonce-derived-from-the-tip); the Runtime refusing to sign a proof at stored + 1 is the ts cell's.
source: contracts-decisions.md R-IMPLICIT-BASELINE (Review B of PR 76, coordinator 09-30)
